Name: Furry Sophia Looks At You
Author: Emreld3000
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
Edits the eyes of Furry Sophia from Lycanglass's SVE Furry Conversion Patch!

I think she looks cute with the big-eyed, cross-eyed look. It changes the feel of her character a lot when she's not constantly side-eying you!
[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]1. Download Furry SVE[/color][/size]
2. Copy/Paste This mod into the same folder you have Furry SVE in.
[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Describe the core features of your mod[/color][/size]
Give Sophia a cute, cross-eyed look.
[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Provide info on additional required steps, resources, or mods[/color][/size]
Furry SVE
[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Full thanks to Lycanglass for making the original portraits![/color][/size]

Downloads.Description: The portraits. Added Makeup Sophia (The portraits she uses on Fridays, Saturdays and Sundays)
